facts.text: I am working on my thesis on the impact of social media on mental health.
I am currently stuck on my methodology chapter.
I want relevant studies on data analysis techniques for social media research.
Our last meeting was on March 1st.
I got suggestions from my group member Rachel on how to improve my data analysis section.
I am considering using a mixed-methods approach combining survey data with social network analysis.
I remember a study by Burke et al. (2010) related to the approach I am considering.
I want an example of how to apply network analysis to my study on social media's impact on mental health.
I am interested in the community detection part of network analysis.
I want to identify specific online communities or sub-networks associated with negative or positive mental health outcomes.
I am wondering whether certain hashtags or keywords are more commonly used in communities with higher rates of depression or anxiety.
I am wondering whether I can use machine learning algorithms to classify users into different mental health categories based on their social media behavior.
I want to train a model to predict whether a user is experiencing symptoms of depression or anxiety based on tweet content and network metrics.
I want examples of specific machine learning algorithms used for mental health classification and how they performed.
